designPosition.summary: A private, case-centred Azure application landing zone uses internal Container Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Azure SQL Database, Blob Storage, Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI and Azure AI Document Intelligence. Managed identities, policy enforcement, immutable audit evidence and isolated Internal Audit storage preserve approved authority boundaries.
designPosition.reason: The Citadel landing-zone composition, separated subscriptions, two-region pattern, hub-spoke topology and evidence-led sizing method are confirmed. Exact tenant parent, subscription IDs, region names, CIDRs/DNS targets and measured capacity caps remain required fail-closed parameters.

landingZoneDecision.name: Citadel
landingZoneDecision.composition: A new case-specific AI-focused platform that uses the Microsoft Azure Landing Zone enterprise-scale platform/application structure as its foundation, adapts the Azure-Samples Foundry Citadel Platform layered AI-governance architecture, and overlays Azure Sovereign Landing Zone policy/control best practices.
landingZoneDecision.accuracyBoundary: Foundry Citadel is an Azure-Samples opinionated architecture, not a standalone Microsoft product and not a replacement for Azure Landing Zones.

managementGroups.purpose: Citadel central platform subscriptions and inherited platform controls.
Internal Audit production assurance with separate ownership and policy.

centralPlatformSubscriptions.purpose: Central policy evidence, management, Defender integration and platform observability; no Stratton workload data.
Primary and recovery regional hubs, Firewall Premium, central Private DNS Resolver and private DNS zones.
Foundry Citadel-derived model/evaluation/policy/approval governance plane; no production inference or assurance verdict.

workloadSubscriptions.purpose: Development and test with separate spokes, resource groups, identities and synthetic data.
Primary and recovery production spokes, production services and confidential data.
Internal Audit-controlled production evidence and verdict services.

landingZoneDecision.regionalPattern: Two approved regions, each with a Citadel hub and production spoke. AI deployments are regional; Global and DataZone deployments are denied.
separationRules: AI governance is not collapsed into the production workload subscription.
Internal Audit assurance is not collapsed into management, AI governance or production workload ownership.
Connectivity and central DNS remain in the Citadel connectivity subscription.
Exact region names and network addresses have no default.

resourceOrganisation.locationCode: Required lookup derived only after General Counsel approves the Azure location.
resourceOrganisation.globalUniquenessSuffix: Deterministic non-sensitive hash of tenant, subscription, environment and location inputs; never a secret.

namingAndTags.denyRule: Production deployment fails if owner, costCenter, approvedLocationEvidenceId or dataClassification is absent.

solutionBuildingBlocks.name: Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access and PIM
solutionBuildingBlocks.purpose: Stratton-controlled identities, least privilege, EU-authorised administration, time-bound elevation and audited emergency access.

solutionBuildingBlocks.name: Private internal ingress
solutionBuildingBlocks.purpose: Private frontend, TLS 1.2 or later, WAF prevention and no Internet-facing application endpoint.

solutionBuildingBlocks.name: Private API boundary
solutionBuildingBlocks.purpose: Entra-authenticated APIs, schema and quota enforcement, correlation and private ingress; publicNetworkAccess is Disabled only after the approved private endpoint and private DNS are proven, with no public fallback.

solutionBuildingBlocks.name: Case, workflow and policy application tier
azureServices: Azure Container Apps workload profiles environment
solutionBuildingBlocks.purpose: Internal case UI/API, explicit state machine, review gates and common fail-closed policy decisions.

solutionBuildingBlocks.name: Controlled asynchronous analysis workers
solutionBuildingBlocks.purpose: Isolated ingestion, extraction, analysis and citation jobs with admission controls, progress and bounded retries.

solutionBuildingBlocks.name: Durable work admission
solutionBuildingBlocks.purpose: Sessions by case, duplicate detection, dead-letter handling and load levelling for document packs.

solutionBuildingBlocks.name: Transactional case and governance store
solutionBuildingBlocks.purpose: Case state, evidence metadata, citations, policy decisions, reviews and append-only logical history; public network disabled.

solutionBuildingBlocks.name: Evidence and quarantine object stores
solutionBuildingBlocks.purpose: Separate quarantine, admitted evidence and temporary-work accounts/containers with private endpoints, versioning and lifecycle rules.

solutionBuildingBlocks.name: Derived evidence retrieval index
solutionBuildingBlocks.purpose: Private vector/text retrieval over admitted derived content with evidence IDs and security filters.

solutionBuildingBlocks.name: Bounded foundation-model inference
solutionBuildingBlocks.purpose: Private assistive inference only; no fine-tuning, no autonomous tools, no Global/DataZone deployment without approval, and no Stratton-data training.

solutionBuildingBlocks.name: Document extraction
solutionBuildingBlocks.purpose: Private prebuilt-layout extraction; custom model training is excluded from Release 1.

solutionBuildingBlocks.name: Secrets and certificate boundary
solutionBuildingBlocks.purpose: Private certificate and secret storage; managed identities preferred; purge protection and soft delete enabled.

solutionBuildingBlocks.name: Versioned configuration and policy
solutionBuildingBlocks.purpose: Versioned non-secret policy pointers and owner-approved policy/evidence records; missing evidence returns deny.

solutionBuildingBlocks.name: Protected audit and verdict evidence
azureServices: Azure Blob Storage with version-level immutability
solutionBuildingBlocks.purpose: Append-only evidence export and Internal Audit-controlled verdict store with no delivery modification rights.

solutionBuildingBlocks.name: Correlated observability
solutionBuildingBlocks.purpose: Redacted metrics, logs and OpenTelemetry traces correlated by case, work item, evidence and policy-decision identifiers.

solutionBuildingBlocks.name: Recovery controls
azureServices: Azure SQL automated PITR and LTR backups with Local or Zone redundancy
Blob versioning, soft delete and immutable retention
solutionBuildingBlocks.purpose: Recover case, evidence, policy and audit state consistently to RTO 4h/RPO 1h across the confirmed primary/recovery pattern. SQL requestedBackupStorageRedundancy has no production default, permits only Local or Zone after regional evidence, and denies implicit paired-region Geo or GeoZone storage.

solutionBuildingBlocks.name: Private network and controlled egress
solutionBuildingBlocks.purpose: Citadel primary/recovery regional hubs connect enterprise IPAM-assigned workload spokes; central DNS, FQDN-filtered egress and denied lateral movement are mandatory.

solutionBuildingBlocks.name: Private software supply store
solutionBuildingBlocks.purpose: Private image registry with vulnerability assessment integration, immutable release tags and no public access.

solutionBuildingBlocks.name: Azure guardrails and cloud security posture
solutionBuildingBlocks.purpose: ALZ-aligned Citadel policies plus Sovereign Landing Zone overlays deny unapproved locations, public data services and Global/DataZone AI; audit private DNS/diagnostics and produce evidence without claiming certification.

solutionBuildingBlocks.name: Independent assurance boundary
solutionBuildingBlocks.purpose: The dedicated sub-citadel-stratton-assurance-prod subscription is Internal Audit-controlled; delivery can submit evidence but cannot issue or alter verdicts.

solutionBuildingBlocks.name: Private Link service plane
solutionBuildingBlocks.purpose: Private data, AI, registry, monitoring and management-plane-adjacent service access with public endpoints disabled where supported.

solutionBuildingBlocks.name: Workload identity and authorisation
azureServices: Microsoft Entra authentication for Azure SQL
solutionBuildingBlocks.purpose: Separate identities per component and environment; no shared credentials or SQL authentication.

solutionBuildingBlocks.name: Quality evaluation service
azureServices: Azure Machine Learning registry optional only for benchmark artefacts
solutionBuildingBlocks.purpose: Reproducible benchmark and negative-test execution with signed input/output manifests; Internal Audit remains verdict owner.
